## Description

[](https://github.com/destr22)

[destr22](https://github.com/destr22)

opened [on Apr 15, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16497#issue-4268120891)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm asking a question and **not** reporting a bug or requesting a feature
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar questions **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

Live streams with the parameter --live-from-start return an error "No video formats found!"  
After the stream ends, when I try again, everything works perfect.  
Without --live-from-start everything works perfect.  
tested on various channels and streams.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output
    
    
    X:\backup\ytdlversion>yt-dlp.exe -vU --cookies-from-browser firefox --cookies bin/cookies.txt --js-runtimes deno --live-from-start -S "res:720" --ffmpeg-location bin --retries 100 --fragment-retries 100 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lOoQCbIlUF8

# Extractors: Availability of DOM query functions #10621

Copy link

New issue

Copy link

Open

Open

Extractors: Availability of DOM query functions#10621

Copy link

Labels

[questionQuestion](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22question%22)Question

[](https://github.com/Lalufu)

## Description

[](https://github.com/Lalufu)

[Lalufu](https://github.com/Lalufu)

opened [on Aug 1, 2024](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10621#issue-2442230799)

Issue body actions

### DO NOT REMOVE OR SKIP THE ISSUE TEMPLATE

  * I understand that I will be **blocked** if I _intentionally_ remove or skip any mandatory* field



### Checklist

  * I'm asking a question and **not** reporting a bug or requesting a feature
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar questions **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)



### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

I am looking into writing a new extractor, and I'm wondering if I'm missing some obvious utility functions for extracting information from a HTML page. I had, maybe naively, expected there to be functions similar to `document.querySelector()` and `document.querySelectorAll()` from JS, which take a more or less abstract path through the document and return matching elements, maybe backed by `BeautifulSoup` or other libraries. I have found the `get_element_*` functions from `utils`, which don't seem to quite do the same thing (I can't seem to look for tags of a certain type?), and looking at other extractors, using regular expressions seems to be pretty popular for some reason instead. There's also some xpath support, but from a quick look nothing seems to utilize this for dealing with HTML.  
Do functions like this exist, and I haven't found them, or is this a discouraged approach for some reason?

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

_No response_

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site

  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### EDIT: This is fixed in the latest release. Update!

* * *

Executable users:
    
    
    yt-dlp -U
    

Users who installed with pip/etc should make sure to include the `[default]` extra when upgrading, e.g.:
    
    
    pip install -U "yt-dlp[default]"
    

The `yt-dlp-ejs` package is already included in the Github release executables and the `default` extra from PyPI. If you have installed yt-dlp **some other way** , then you may need to add this to your command the first time you run the new version:
    
    
    --remote-components ejs:github
    

And so that you actually benefit from the fix, make sure you have a [supported JavaScript runtime installed](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS)

* * *

### Checklist

  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

# [YouTube] Provide styling information for comments #16499

[YouTube] Provide styling information for comments#16499

Copy link

Labels

[low-priority](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22low-priority%22)[site-enhancementFeature request for some website](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22site-enhancement%22)Feature request for some website[site:youtube](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22site%3Ayoutube%22)[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

[](https://github.com/Pasu4)

## Description

[](https://github.com/Pasu4)

[Pasu4](https://github.com/Pasu4)

opened [on Apr 15, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16499#issue-4269561705)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a site-specific feature
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Example URLs

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f4YwpciOb8c> (Comment by `@Pasu4` contains italic, bold and strikethrough)  
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Qy4agD90vy4> (Comment by `@Pasu4` contains nested style ranges)

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Currently, the YouTube extractor only extracts the unstyled text of comments. For example, a comment written as "_Lorem_ *ipsum* -dolor-" (displayed as "_Lorem_ **ipsum** ~~dolor~~ ") is returned as "Lorem ipsum dolor" with the styling characters removed. It would be useful to also be able to additionally get the original text of the comment containing these styling characters, or if that is not possible, the style ranges. Looking at the the output of running with `--write-comments --dump-json`, no such information is returned, and there seems to be no command line argument or downloader argument that enables it.

## Use case

I use yt-dlp to fetch a comment containing timestamps from a video for [Pasu4/vedal-subathon-info](https://github.com/Pasu4/vedal-subathon-info). I want to convert the comment into Markdown, however, since yt-dlp only returns unstyled text, this is not possible using only yt-dlp. Currently I use the YouTube API as a replacement as it is able to return the original comment text with the styling characters present, but it requires a token, which may deter potential contributors.

## Investigation

By looking at the data returned from requests when loading the video, I was able to find an array of style ranges, located in the same object I believe the comment text is extracted from. The jq path for this array is (in my case) `.frameworkUpdates.entityBatchUpdate.mutations.[1].payload.commentEntityPayload.properties.content.styleRuns` (the comment text is extracted from `.frameworkUpdates.entityBatchUpdate.mutations.[1].payload.commentEntityPayload.properties.content.content`). Through debugging I confirmed that this property is accessible in the [`_extract_comment`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/2c28ee5d76d2c0d350407fd81dbdd71394b67993/yt_dlp/extractor/youtube/_video.py#L2383) method.

The objects contained in the `styleRuns` array have the following properties (purely based on observation):

  * `startIndex`: The character the range starts at.
  * `length`: The length of the range.
  * `weightLabel`: Either `"FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL"` (normal) or `"FONT_WEIGHT_MEDIUM"` (bold)
  * `strikethrough`: Either `"LINE_STYLE_SINGLE"` or undefined (i.e. the property is not present in the object)
  * `italic`: Either `true` or undefined



Additional observations:

  * There may be sections of text in the comment that are not covered by a styling range, these are styled normally.
  * Styling ranges do not seem to overlap. "*_Hello_ World*" ("**_Hello_ World**") would result in two styling ranges ("Hello" and " World").
  * Timestamps have a styling range even though it does not change the style.

I also found a property that contains the original comment text with styling characters preserved (jq: `.frameworkUpdates.entityBatchUpdate.mutations.[4].payload.engagementToolbarSurfaceEntityPayload.menuCommand.innertubeCommand.menuEndpoint.menu.menuRenderer.items.[0].menuNavigationItemRenderer.navigationEndpoint.updateCommentDialogEndpoint.dialog.commentDialogRenderer.editableText.runs.[0].text`), however, it seems to only exists for comments written by myself.

## Proposed solutions

  1. Generate equivalent styling characters that would result in the same styling, but may not exactly match the original.  
Proposed example output: 
         
         {
           // ...
           "comments": [
             {
               "id": "UgzhAXXpHfr6zuVlVy54AaABAg",
               "parent": "root",

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required



### Region

Canada

### Example URLs

<https://piczel.tv/watch/Chrisceon>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

The site piczel, which I believe has support for image galleries, also has livestream capabilities. Some of these may require logins as they have gated 18+ streams, but I believe also have nongated streams to my knowledge.

URL provided for test is someone who is currently streaming at the time of creating this ticket.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/HenryCVR)

[HenryCVR](https://github.com/HenryCVR)

opened [on Mar 6, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16146#issue-4033069045)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Poland/Europe (Should be available worldwide)

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

**What the problem is ?**  
yt-dlp fails to fetch formats otehr than Preview and 360p even if higher resolution and/or source formats are available:  
`yt-dlp -F` output snippet for a 1080p video with available formats: source (1080p), 540p, 360p, preview:
    
    
    ID      EXT RESOLUTION │ PROTO │ VCODEC  ACODEC
    ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    preview mp4 unknown    │ https │ unknown unknown
    360     mp4 360p       │ https │ unknown unknown
    

**How it could be fixed**  
All available formats should be fetched by yt-dlp, as they were before the sites recent temporary unavailability and recovery.

**How your proposed solution would look like**  
Compare the current and old JSON, fetched by yt-dlp and extract the missing formats.
    
    
    ID      EXT RESOLUTION │ PROTO │ VCODEC  ACODEC
    ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    preview mp4 unknown    │ https │ unknown unknown
    source mp4 1080p    │ https │ unknown unknown
    540      mp4 540p       │ https │ unknown unknown
    360     mp4 360p       │ https │ unknown unknown
    

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/gom3sr)

[gom3sr](https://github.com/gom3sr)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Brazil

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

yt-dlp seems to have problems parsing video titles that have the `'` character.

Consider, for example, this title here: `My fake stepcousin couldn't help himself (...)`

yt-dlp replaces the character `'` with the sequence `&#039;`

And so the file name becomes `My fake stepcousin couldn&#039;t help himself(...)`

If you use `--embed-metadata`, the bad name will also be added as the video title.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Indonesia

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Iwara got taken down during new years, and now they have recovered with a new hosting service. However, this led to yt-dlp being unable to download from Iwara.  
Now I've found out that they changed their API URL to `apiq.iwara.tv` but simply changing the URL in the extractor introduces a new issue, which is that the video qualities are limited to preview and 360p.  
Then I've figured out that if I visit the site in a browser then go to the Network tab in DevTools then click the `filesq.iwara.tv` request, I can see that there is a request header named `X-Version`, and if I fetch `filesq.iwara.tv` with that header and its value only then will it give every available quality.  
I tried to figure out by myself where the `X-Version` value comes from but unfortunately that seems to be beyond my abilities.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

Issue: The eporner extractor is failing with "Unable to extract hash". Tested with the latest master branch environment.

  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

USA

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I am unable to download videos hosted on vids.io that require not only a password but also an email address. The Email is then used in a watermark on the web player (along with IP and a GUID).

Trying to download the video with just the URL will say "This video is password-protected; use the --video-password option".

Trying again with the correct password gives the error "Unable to extract any SproutVideo embed url".

I've tried including the cookie from vids.io as well, and that will act like it is downloading the video, but everything is returning 403 Forbidden. I can see it's including the vemail parameter in the URL when the cookies are included.

I've included debug output with just the password as well as debug output when including the cookies. I've redacted my email from the logs for privacy.

I can provide the video password privately.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required



### Region

Czech republic

### Example URLs

<https://freesex.cz/content/18125-divoke-brunetky-v-rozkosi>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

The site uses a simple HTML structure where the video source is directly available in the page source.

  * Video URL: Can be found in the `src` attribute of a source/video tag (ending in .mp4).
  * URL Path: The link is usually relative (starting with /freesex/...), so it requires prepending '<https://freesex.cz>' to make it a full URL.
  * Title: Can be extracted from the `<title>` tag, usually prefixed with 'FreeSex.cz - '.



I have verified that the direct MP4 links can be downloaded using yt-dlp when the full URL is provided manually. Adding a native extractor would simplify the process.

I have included the verbose output below, showing that the current version of yt-dlp does not recognize this URL structure.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

However, it seems that yt-dlp does not support them.

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

# Download subtitles with multiple formats in the same format #16475

Download subtitles with multiple formats in the same format#16475

[#16488](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/16488)

## Description

[](https://github.com/Anuskuss)

[Anuskuss](https://github.com/Anuskuss)

opened [on Apr 11, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16475#issue-4245755846)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

(Sorry if the title isn't self-explanatory because it's using the same noun to describe 2 different things; I was trying to make it as google-able as possible.)

I'm trying to download subtitles from a M3U8. This is the output of `yt-dlp --list-subs`:
    
    
    Language Formats
    en       vtt, vtt
    

It lists 2 "formats" which are in the same "format" but are actually 2 different subtitles: the first one being the standard subtitles and the second one the SDH subtitles. It's currently (AFAICT) not possible to download both, yt-dlp treats them as the same but in different "flavours".

This is how the M3U8 looks like:
    
    
    #EXT-X-MEDIA:TYPE=SUBTITLES,GROUP-ID="subs0",NAME="English",LANGUAGE="en",AUTOSELECT=YES,DEFAULT=YES,URI="https://example.com/index-f1.m3u8"
    #EXT-X-MEDIA:TYPE=SUBTITLES,GROUP-ID="subs0",NAME="English SDH",LANGUAGE="en",AUTOSELECT=YES,DEFAULT=NO,CHARACTERISTICS="public.accessibility.describes-spoken-dialog,public.accessibility.describes-music-and-sound",URI="https://example.com/index-f2.m3u8"

For whatever reason I wasn't able to download the `index-f2.m3u8` through yt-dlp nor ffmpeg (always errors with 403) even though wget worked fine. What I ended up doing was downloading all `*.vtt` separately and them merging them with cat (and cleaning up the duplicate `WEBVTT` headers).

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/coletdjnz)

[coletdjnz](https://github.com/coletdjnz)

opened [on Dec 19, 2023](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8803#issue-2048048805)

Issue body actions

### DO NOT REMOVE OR SKIP THE ISSUE TEMPLATE

  * I understand that I will be **blocked** if I _intentionally_ remove or skip any mandatory* field



### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Low priority issue but if you provide an HTTPS proxy and try to use a file (or data?) url it will fail as the urllib handler does not support HTTPS proxies.

file urls do not need a proxy. Same goes for data urls too.

This may not be restricted to just HTTPS proxies. Other options that only apply for HTTP requests may also cause similar issues.

Perhaps the file and data url handling should be split out into a separate request handler. Alternatively can try mangle exclusions into `UrllibRH` but that might get messy.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# Capturing HTTP traffic into a HAR file #3189

New issue

Copy link

New issue

Copy link

Open

Open

Capturing HTTP traffic into a HAR file#3189

Copy link

Labels

[PR-neededFeatures that maintainers will not work on; but PRs are welcome](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22PR-needed%22)Features that maintainers will not work on; but PRs are welcome[core:networkingcore networking related](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22core%3Anetworking%22)core networking related[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request[low-priority](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22low-priority%22)

[](https://github.com/fstirlitz)

## Description

[](https://github.com/fstirlitz)

[fstirlitz](https://github.com/fstirlitz)

opened [on Mar 25, 2022](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3189#issue-1180503852)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a feature request
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I'm running yt-dlp version **2022.03.08.1**. ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues including closed ones. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)



### Description

HTTP Archive (HAR) is a JSON-based format capable of storing a log of HTTP(S) traffic. It can be readily generated by Chrome and Firefox developer tools. It would be tremendously useful if yt-dlp could generate this kind of file as well when capturing its own traffic. It would for example help when triaging unreproducible issues: if we ever get a report of an issue that fails to reproduce, we may be able to ask the user to attach a compressed `.har` file generated by yt-dlp to the ticket. The closest thing `yt-dlp` offers right now are the options `--write-pages` and `--print-traffic`, neither of which is readily suitable for short-to-medium-term storage.

However, since a dump of HTTP traffic can contain cookies, IP addresses and other sensitive data, we would have to either encrypt the HAR file or attempt to redact those data. We may also need a similar tool for redacting/encrypting HAR files obtained from a browser inspector, which may also be very helpful, especially when diagnosing issues with geo-blocked sites. Posting a HAR file exported from the browser could then serve as a somewhat safer alternative to credential sharing.

Reactions are currently unavailable

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

united states

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Hi, thanks for this wonderful tool :)  
I used the latest release to download:  
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pqw4MUvB7lE>  
It plays fine on the site, but the downloaded copy has whole seconds' worth of frames out of order, and some smaller sync problems, occasionally throughout.  
I discovered that this happens when using:  
`-S res,+vcodec:h264`  
When I went back to using my old method which I got from somewhere:  
`--format 'bestvideo[height<=1080]+bestaudio/bestvideo+bestaudio/bestaudio/hls-1288/low'`  
I got a version without issues.  
This may indicate that YouTube encoded badly but I wanted to check, because the working file is smaller than the broken file. It appears the broken one is x264 and the working one is vp09. Is one of them presumably better in terms of having the ideal download quality?  
I went with the newer -S version because the other version sometimes resulted in a "no formats available" error.

I suppose then this post has two purposes. One, is there a problem with yt-dlp? And two, what is the best way to download the best highest quality of video and audio, across all sites?

thanks again!

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

United States

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I found that one livestream download keeps unexpectedly ending despite the stream continuing. This has happened on two different live streams from on [this channel](https://www.youtube.com/@courtroom3386) today. When trying to resume, it indicates it was already downloaded, so I have to delete the prematurely completed file for yt-dlp to grab and download it again, only for it to prematurely end again while the live stream keeps broadcasting.

This is currently happening on this video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=de3STw8r6mo>

I captured debug logs, which are copied below; the download had ended prematurely, and it's still streaming/live at the same URL as I write this.

I download many other live streams from other channels that don't experience this issue, but for some reason, multiple videos on this channel keep downloading early, requiring me to delete the downloaded incomplete file mp4 file and manually download again using the same command.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Issue body actions

On Rutube, I selected several videos labeled HDR and requested information.

All videos are not HDR, obviously I'm doing something wrong....  
There is no 10‑bit VP9 or HEVC → there is no real HDR stream for download

Is it possible to get HDR or only SDR through yt-dlp?
    
    
    with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL({
        'format': 'bestvideo+bestaudio/best',
        'merge_output_format': 'mp4',
        'outtmpl': os.path.join('/uploads/', f'rutube-{args.video}.%(ext)s'),
        'verbose': True,
        'ignoreerrors': True
    }) as ydl:
        info = ydl.extract_info(f"https://rutube.ru/video/{args.video}/", download=True)

# [twitch] FFmpegFixupM3u8PP causes video truncation/compression for long Twitch VODs #15825

## Description

[](https://github.com/ustclan)

[ustclan](https://github.com/ustclan)

opened [on Feb 4, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15825#issue-3896346637)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Description:  
When downloading long Twitch VODs (2+ hours), the last 30 minutes of video gets compressed into just a few seconds, resulting in black screen for the remainder of the video. The issue is caused by the FFmpegFixupM3u8PP post-processor.

Reproduction Steps:

Download a long Twitch VOD (2+ hours):
    
    
    yt-dlp -f '480p' https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2670757337
    

Play the downloaded video

Observe that the final 30 minutes are either black screen or compressed into just a few seconds of playback

Affected URL:

<https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2670757337>

Root Cause:  
The issue occurs in the FFmpegFixupM3u8PP post-processor when it tries to fix MPEG-TS in MP4 container. The problematic code is in yt_dlp/postprocessor/ffmpeg.py:
    
    
    python
    def run(self, info):
        if all(self._needs_fixup(info)):
            args = ['-f', 'mp4']
            if self.get_audio_codec(info['filepath']) == 'aac':
                args.extend(['-bsf:a', 'aac_adtstoasc'])  # This causes issues
            self._fixup('Fixing MPEG-TS in MP4 container', info['filepath'], [
                *self.stream_copy_opts(), *args])
    

The -bsf:a aac_adtstoasc bitstream filter appears to cause timestamp corruption when processing long MPEG-TS streams, resulting in the final portion of the video being compressed/misaligned.

Expected Behavior:  
The entire video should be preserved with correct timing and duration.

Actual Behavior:  
The last portion (approximately 30 minutes) of long videos gets compressed into a few seconds, showing as black screen.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

United States

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Ongoing membership live streams appear on the website under the `/live` tab, but do not appear when trying to download the tab with `yt-dlp`.

Once the stream is complete (not live), it appears normally.  
The stream _does_ appear when giving yt-dlp the `/membership` tab instead.

This is with my main Google/YouTube account, so I am not willing to share the account details in this case, sorry.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I am encountering an issue with downloading multiple videos from iQIYI. About a week ago, everything was working fine. However, now I am consistently getting the following error:

Unable to download webpage: HTTP Error 413: Request Entity Too Large

To temporarily resolve the issue, I have to repeatedly refresh the iQIYI page and export a new cookie. This workaround is inconvenient and disruptive.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

# Plugin Development

Jump to bottom

coletdjnz edited this page Jan 2, 2023 · [2 revisions](/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Plugin-Development/_history)

# How do I create a plugin for yt-dlp?

A template plugin package repository is available at [yt-dlp/yt-dlp-sample-plugins](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-sample-plugins).

  * To see how to write extractors in general, see the [yt-dlp developer instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-instructions).
  * For information regarding the plugin spec, see the [plugins section of the yt-dlp README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#plugins).



## Getting Started

  1. [Create a new repository based on yt-dlp/yt-dlp-sample-plugins](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-sample-plugins/generate)
  2. Check out the source code with: `git clone git@github.com:YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME/YOUR_REPOSITORY.git`
  3. Configure your IDE's run and debug configuration (optional)
  4. Write your plugin code in the `yt_dlp_plugins/<type>` folder (where type is either `extractor` or `postprocessor`). See the sample plugins provided and the [yt-dlp developer instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-instructions) for more details. 
     * Some instructions given will not apply to plugin development, but should give you a good idea on what to do.
     * The method for testing extractor plugins is the same as with built-in ones.
  5. Configure your plugin package
  6. [Add](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-add) the new files, [commit](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-commit) them and [push](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-push) the result, like this: 
         
         $ git add yt_dlp_plugins setup.cfg README.md
          $ git commit -m 'Add yourplugin plugin'
          $ git push origin master
         




* * *

## Configuring your plugin package

  1. Modify [setup.cfg](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-sample-plugins/blob/master/setup.cfg) with your plugin's name and version. It is recommended to bump the version whenever you make changes or a new release.
  2. Update the installation instructions on [README.md](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-sample-plugins/blob/master/README.md) to point to this repository.
  3. Add `yt-dlp-plugins` to the repository tags for discoverability.
  4. Be sure to remove any of the sample extractors/post-processors.



## Run and debug configuration

  1. Set your IDE's run configuration to point to the `yt_dlp` Python module.
  2. Add your project's root directory containing `yt_dlp_plugins` to `PYTHONPATH` environment variable (this may not be necessary with some IDE run configurations).
  3. The `yt_dlp_plugins` folder should be automatically picked up by yt-dlp (run with `-v` to check).



## Importing extractors from other plugins
    
    
    from yt_dlp_plugins.extractor.example import ExampleIE

This works regardless of where the `example` plugin is installed on the system, as long as yt-dlp can find it. Your IDE may not be able to resolve the import, but it will work at runtime.

If the user does not have the `example` plugin installed, the import will fail and your extractor will not be imported (but yt-dlp will continue to run).

The same applies for any other plugin type.

## Poetry configuration

If you want your plugin to be installable with [poetry](https://python-poetry.org/), you can add the following to your `pyproject.toml`:
    
    
    [tool.poetry]
    ...
    packages = [{ include = "yt_dlp_plugins" }]
    ...
    

See the [Poetry documentation](https://python-poetry.org/docs/pyproject/#packages) for more details.

# Maintainers

This file lists the maintainers of yt-dlp and their major contributions. See the [Changelog](/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/Changelog.md) for more details.

You can also find lists of all [contributors of yt-dlp](/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTORS) and [authors of youtube-dl](https://github.com/ytdl-org/youtube-dl/blob/master/AUTHORS)

## Core Maintainers

Core Maintainers are responsible for reviewing and merging contributions, publishing releases, and steering the overall direction of the project.

**You can contact the core maintainers via`maintainers@yt-dlp.org`.** This email address is **NOT** a support channel. [Open an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/new/choose) if you need help or want to report a bug.

### [coletdjnz](https://github.com/coletdjnz)

[](https://github.com/sponsors/coletdjnz)

  * Overhauled the networking stack and implemented support for `requests` and `curl_cffi` (`--impersonate`) HTTP clients
  * Reworked the plugin architecture to support installing plugins across all yt-dlp distributions (exe, pip, etc.)
  * Implemented support for external JavaScript runtimes/engines
  * Maintains support for YouTube
  * Added and fixed support for various other sites



### [bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)

  * Rewrote and maintains the build/release workflows and the self-updater: executables, automated/nightly/master releases, `--update-to`
  * Overhauled external downloader cookie handling
  * Helped in implementing support for external JavaScript runtimes/engines
  * Added `--cookies-from-browser` support for Firefox containers
  * Maintains support for sites like YouTube, Vimeo, Twitter, TikTok, etc
  * Added support for various sites



### [Grub4K](https://github.com/Grub4K)

[](https://github.com/sponsors/Grub4K) [](https://ko-fi.com/Grub4K)

  * `--update-to`, self-updater rewrite, automated/nightly/master releases
  * Reworked internals like `traverse_obj`, various core refactors and bugs fixes
  * Implemented proper progress reporting for parallel downloads
  * Implemented support for external JavaScript runtimes/engines
  * Improved/fixed/added Bundestag, crunchyroll, pr0gramm, Twitter, WrestleUniverse etc



## Inactive Core Maintainers

### [pukkandan](https://github.com/pukkandan)

[](https://ko-fi.com/pukkandan) [](https://github.com/sponsors/pukkandan)

  * Founder of the fork
  * Lead Maintainer from 2021-2024



### [shirt](https://github.com/shirt-dev)

[](https://ko-fi.com/shirt)

  * Multithreading (`-N`) and aria2c support for fragment downloads
  * Support for media initialization and discontinuity in HLS
  * The self-updater (`-U`)



### [Ashish0804](https://github.com/Ashish0804)

[](https://ko-fi.com/ashish0804)

  * Added support for new websites BiliIntl, DiscoveryPlusIndia, OlympicsReplay, PlanetMarathi, ShemarooMe, Utreon, Zee5 etc
  * Added playlist/series downloads for Hotstar, ParamountPlus, Rumble, SonyLIV, Trovo, TubiTv, Voot etc
  * Improved/fixed support for HiDive, HotStar, Hungama, LBRY, LinkedInLearning, Mxplayer, SonyLiv, TV2, Vimeo, VLive etc



### [sepro](https://github.com/seproDev)

  * UX improvements: Warn when ffmpeg is missing, warn when double-clicking exe
  * Helped in implementing support for external JavaScript runtimes/engines
  * Code cleanup: Remove dead extractors, mark extractors as broken, enable/apply ruff rules
  * Improved/fixed/added ArdMediathek, DRTV, Floatplane, MagentaMusik, Naver, Nebula, OnDemandKorea, Vbox7 etc



## Triage Maintainers

Triage Maintainers are frequent contributors who can manage issues and pull requests.

  * [gamer191](https://github.com/gamer191)
  * [garret1317](https://github.com/garret1317)
  * [pzhlkj6612](https://github.com/pzhlkj6612)
  * [DTrombett](https://github.com/dtrombett)
  * [doe1080](https://github.com/doe1080)

# EJS

Jump to bottom

bashonly edited this page Apr 5, 2026 · [2 revisions](/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS/_history)

# External JS Scripts Setup Guide

To download from YouTube, yt-dlp needs to solve JavaScript challenges presented by YouTube using an external JavaScript runtime.

This involves running challenge solver scripts maintained at [yt-dlp-ejs](https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs). Depending on your yt-dlp installation method, you may need to set up and enable these components manually.

This guide will help you set up and enable the necessary components based on your yt-dlp installation method.

Note

EJS replaces the prior JSInterp and PhantomJS based approach. For YouTube both are no longer used. PhantomJS is still being used for a few other extractors, but is planned to be deprecated in the near future.

## Setup steps

  1. Install a supported JavaScript runtime
  2. Install EJS challenge solver scripts



## Step 1: Install a supported JavaScript Runtime

JS Runtime | Summary  
---|---  
Deno (recommended) | Enabled by default.  
Node | Enable with `--js-runtimes node`  
Bun | Enable with `--js-runtimes bun`  
QuickJS | Enable with `--js-runtimes quickjs`  
  
### deno

Tip

Recommended

<https://deno.com>

#### Installation instructions

Minimum supported version: `2.0.0`

Download from <https://docs.deno.com/runtime/getting_started/installation/> or from your package manager.

When grabbing deno manually from the [Github release assets](https://github.com/denoland/deno/releases/latest) you will need to download `deno` and not `denort`.

#### Enable

Deno is enabled by default. To supply an optional path, use `--js-runtimes deno:/path/to/deno`

#### Notes

  * Code is run with restricted permissions (e.g, no file system or network access)
  * Supports downloading EJS script dependencies from [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/) (`--remote-components ejs:npm`).



* * *

### node

<https://nodejs.org>

#### Installation instructions

Minimum supported version: `20.0.0`

Download from <https://nodejs.org/en/download/> or from your package manager.

#### Enable

Enable with `--js-runtimes node` or `--js-runtimes node:/path/to/node`.

It is recommended to add this to your [yt-dlp configuration file](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp?tab=readme-ov-file#configuration) to avoid needing to pass it every time.

#### Notes

  * Runs code with [_some_ permissions restricted](https://nodejs.org/api/permissions.html).



* * *

### bun

<https://bun.com>

#### Installation instructions

Minimum supported version: `1.0.31`

Download from <https://bun.com/docs/installation> or from your package manager.

#### Enable

Enable with `--js-runtimes bun` or `--js-runtimes bun:/path/to/bun`.

It is recommended to add this to your [yt-dlp configuration file](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp?tab=readme-ov-file#configuration) to avoid needing to pass it every time.

#### Notes

  * No permission restrictions available. Scripts have full file system and network access.
  * Supports downloading EJS script dependencies from [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/) (`--remote-components ejs:npm`).
  * No support for SOCKS proxies when downloading EJS script dependencies from npm.



* * *

### QuickJS / QuickJS-NG

<https://bellard.org/quickjs/> / <https://quickjs-ng.github.io/quickjs/>

#### Installation instructions

Minimum supported QuickJS version: `2023-12-9`

All versions of QuickJS-NG are supported.

Download from <https://bellard.org/quickjs/> / <https://quickjs-ng.github.io/quickjs/installation> or from your package manager.

#### Enable

Enable with `--js-runtimes quickjs` or `--js-runtimes quickjs:/path/to/qjs`.

It is recommended to add this to your [yt-dlp configuration file](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp?tab=readme-ov-file#configuration) to avoid needing to pass it every time.

#### Notes

  * QuickJS versions prior to `2025-4-26` are missing optimizations which can lead to execution times of several minutes.
  * QuickJS-NG versions prior to `0.12.0 `are missing optimizations which can lead to execution times of several minutes.
  * Both QuickJS and QuickJS-NG do not fully allow executing files from stdin, so yt-dlp will create temporary files for each EJS script execution. This can theoretically lead to time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) vulnerabilities.



## Step 2: Install EJS challenge solver scripts

yt-dlp distribution | EJS scripts installation options  
---|---  
Official PyInstaller-bundled executable (e.g. `yt-dlp.exe`, `yt-dlp_macos`, `yt-dlp_linux`, etc) | No additional action required. All the necessary JavaScript components will be bundled with these executables.  
PyPI package (e.g. installed with pip, pipx, etc): | \- Install and upgrade yt-dlp with `default` dependency group  
\- or enable npm downloads (deno/bun only)  
\- or enable GitHub downloads  
  
Official zipimport binary (the `yt-dlp` Unix executable) | No additional action required. All the necessary JavaScript components will be bundled with these executables.  
Third-party package users (e.g. installed with pacman, brew, etc) | The will depend on if your third-party package repository ships or bundles the EJS script package with yt-dlp.  
  
If it does not (or it is out of date):   
\- enable npm downloads (deno/bun only)   
\- or enable GitHub downloads  
  
  
### Option 1: Install the yt-dlp-ejs python package

yt-dlp ships a companion package, `yt-dlp-ejs`, which contains all the EJS scripts.

If you installed yt-dlp using the PyPI package (e.g. with pip or pipx), install _and upgrade_ yt-dlp with the `default` dependency group:

i.e. `pip install -U "yt-dlp[default]"`

The default dependency group includes the `yt-dlp-ejs` package.

Refer to <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Installation#with-pip> for more details.

Alternatively, if you only want to install the EJS package, you can install the `yt-dlp-ejs` package directly from PyPI. The version MUST match the version specified in yt-dlp's `pyproject.toml` for the version of yt-dlp you are using.

Warning

This library SHOULD be updated alongside yt-dlp to avoid running an outdated version. The version MUST be a supported version as per yt-dlp's pyproject.toml file. yt-dlp may bump the minimum version on updates without warning, and old versions will be ignored by yt-dlp.

### Option 2: Enable EJS script downloads from npm

Important

This option only works with Deno and Bun runtimes, which support downloading npm packages on-the-fly.

To enable this, supply `--remote-components ejs:npm` to yt-dlp. It is recommended to add this to your [yt-dlp configuration file](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp?tab=readme-ov-file#configuration) to avoid needing to pass it every time and allow automatic updates.

### Option 3: Enable EJS script downloads from GitHub

yt-dlp can automatically download the EJS scripts directly from GitHub (<https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs>).

To enable this, supply `--remote-components ejs:github` to yt-dlp. It is recommended to add this to your [yt-dlp configuration file](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp?tab=readme-ov-file#configuration) to avoid needing to pass it every time and allow automatic updates.

Note

This method may not work if GitHub and GitHub release assets are not accessible from your network. This includes if you are using yt-dlp with a IPv6 IP-only (e.g., `--force-ipv6`)

## Plugins

You can install alternatives to the built-in JS challenge solvers through plugins.

### Featured Plugins:

  * [yt-dlp-apple-webkit-jsi](https://github.com/grqz/yt-dlp-apple-webkit-jsi) by [grqz](https://github.com/grqz)
    * Experimental Apple WebKit JS Challenge Provider plugin for yt-dlp. Should work on most Apple devices. _Maintained by a yt-dlp maintainer_



Check out the [yt-dlp-jsc-provider](https://github.com/topics/yt-dlp-jsc-provider) GitHub topic for more JSC Provider plugins.

For developers, refer to the [JSC Provider developer documentation](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/yt_dlp/extractor/youtube/jsc/README.md)

  * **Please note: Currently only the base JavaScript Challenge Provider API is public. The API to hook into yt-dlp's EJS scripts is private at this time due to ongoing development with potential breaking changes; it may be made public in the future.**

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Sometimes the downloads suddenly stop responding, sometimes at ~80%, ~90%, when this happens I have to end the process and start it again to complete the download.

After a few hours of downloading random content and witnessing these behaviors, I found a URL that always stops at 100%, the download never completes. The sample URL is in the report, I believe it will be invalid after a few hours, but I can generate a new one anytime, just let me know.

Using `--compat-options no-external-downloader-progress` works around these behaviors.

# Subtitle file is not deleted after being embedded #630

New issue

Copy link

New issue

Copy link

Closed

Closed

Subtitle file is not deleted after being embedded#630

Copy link

Labels

[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request

[](https://github.com/35609902357)

## Description

[](https://github.com/35609902357)

[35609902357](https://github.com/35609902357)

opened [on Aug 5, 2021](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/630#issue-961337314)

Issue body actions

Embedding subtitles in the video and also keeping the file is pointless and it results in 2 identical tracks for the same video.

The default behavior of youtube-dl is to keep the file if not embedded and delete it if embedded, this is smarter because the `-k` flag can be used if someone wants to embed and also keep the file, but there is no flag to automatically remove the file once embedded.

Maybe adding a flag like `--keep-subs-file` would solve the problem for those few users who might want both, but the default should be what youtube-dl does, keep the file if external subs or embed and delete.

Reactions are currently unavailable

# Extractors
